title: PDF Forms – Make a Fillable PDF Form Online, No Upload
description: Make a PDF fillable in your browser: add text boxes, checkboxes, drop-downs, choice buttons, dates and a signature box, then save. Free, no upload.
heading: PDF Forms
subtitle: Turn any PDF into a fillable form with text boxes, checkboxes, drop-downs and more; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Create a fillable PDF form online from a form you already have as a PDF: pick a field type, click or drag where it goes, give it a name and set it up, with choices, a starting value or Required. The saved copy works in Acrobat, Preview, browsers and Fill PDF here. Fields the PDF already has are kept. Your file never leaves your device.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is handled by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: Seven field types
features.text: Text, long text, checkbox, drop-down, choice buttons, date and a signature box.

features.title: Works everywhere
features.text: Standard PDF form fields, filled in by any PDF reader, including Fill PDF on this site.

stepsTitle: How to make a fillable PDF

steps.title: Choose your PDF
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop the PDF of your form on the page.

steps.title: Place the fields
steps.text: Pick a field type, then click or drag on the page where it should go.

steps.title: Set each field up
steps.text: Select a field to name it, add choices, a starting value or mark it as required.

steps.title: Save a copy
steps.text: Click Save a copy, check the preview and download the fillable PDF.

handles: Text and long text boxes, with a starting value.
Checkboxes, drop-downs and choice buttons, with their choices and a starting choice.
Date fields that Acrobat keeps in the yyyy-mm-dd format, and an empty signature box readers can sign in.
PDFs that already have fields: they are kept, and new names can't clash with them.
limits: Starting values and drop-down choices can use Latin letters only for now; Arabic can still be typed into the fields when the form is filled.
No calculations or scripts, apart from the date format.
The signature box is an empty field; signing it with a certificate needs a reader such as Acrobat.
PDFs that need a password to open can't be read; remove the password first.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: Will the form work in Acrobat and on phones?
faq.answer: Yes. The fields are standard PDF form fields, so Acrobat, Preview, browsers and phone PDF apps can fill them in.

faq.question: How do I fill in the form afterwards?
faq.answer: In any PDF reader, or here with Fill PDF, which also flattens the answers into the page.

faq.question: Can a field have Arabic text?
faq.answer: People can type Arabic into the fields when they fill the form. Starting values and drop-down choices need Latin letters for now.

faq.question: What happens to fields the PDF already has?
faq.answer: They are kept as they are. A new field can't take the name of an existing one, because two fields with one name share their answer.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.
